purpose: Traceable source catalog for the initial operational HoReCa knowledge graph. Source records describe provenance, not universal validity.

sources.sensitive_content: Generalized; organization and personal identifiers excluded.

sources.title: Система операционного управления — управленческая эффективность
sources.locator: PPTX; 20 slides; management functions, situational leadership, work maturity levels, GROW
limitations: Training framework, not validated universal psychometric assessment.
Work maturity is evaluated relative to a task, not as a permanent label for a person.
Slide 11 contains a visual matrix and must be interpreted with its image, not text extraction alone.

sources.title: Календарный план директора
sources.date_status: historical October dates; year not stated in workbook; current applicability not verified
sources.locator: XLSX; sheets: «календарный план», «11-15.10», «18-19.10»; main sheet rows 2–42; weekly plan/fact sheets rows 3–43; workbook inspected directly
limitations: Time budgets, frequency labels and the 21-workday calculation base are examples from one organization-specific operating model, not universal standards.
Blank cells, blank planned occurrence counts and blank plan/fact cells are not zero and are not proof that a task is unnecessary or was not performed.

Weekly sheets contain historical plan/fact observations; sheet «18-19.10» repeats weekday headings for 11–15.10 and has predominantly blank fact cells, so its date range and actual execution cannot be reliably inferred.

The workbook does not consistently specify accountable owners, evidence records, acceptance criteria or escalation routes for each activity; these must remain unknown unless another source supports them.
Some abbreviations (РУ, ШП, FBC, МС, СШ, СЗ, ТМЦ) are not expanded in the workbook and are retained without speculative interpretation.
Historical plan/fact values are not benchmarks and must not be generalized to other restaurant formats or current organizations.

sources.title: Модель бизнес-процессов ресторана
sources.locator: XLSX; sheet БМ; 336 rows; process hierarchy and functional actions
limitations: Contains owner names and corporate references; these are excluded from generalized graph.
Some legacy terms, software references and legal/tax workflows may be obsolete or jurisdiction-specific.
A listed process is not proof that it is implemented or legally required.

sources.title: Регламент ресторана
sources.date_status: Document states edition 01.09.2025; approval status and current applicability require confirmation.
sources.locator: Original DOC; 130 pages; cover states «Руководящие документы для ресторанов корпорации (формат фаст-фуд) на 01.09.25»; contents include operations, production/sales, safety, documents, finance, labor, procurement, iiko, inspections, delivery, HR, facilities and 29 appendices.
limitations: Internal corporate document, not a universal industry standard.
Cover identifies an edition date of 01.09.2025; signature/approval status and current validity were not independently confirmed.
Document includes legacy dates, historical system instructions and organization-specific roles, limits, forms and workflows; each item requires current local validation.
Legal, tax, payroll, employment and food-safety statements require current official-source review for the relevant jurisdiction.
Personal names, addresses, supplier details, internal contacts and corporate identifiers must not be reproduced in generalized methodology.

sources.title: Программа производственного контроля ресторана — проект 2026
sources.date_status: Document identifies itself as a 2026 draft; approval date and authorized signature are blank.
sources.locator: DOCX; 12 pages; PPK overview, establishment profile, HACCP framework, production-control measures, proposed laboratory programme, preliminary CCP table and register of 16 referenced work instructions.
limitations: Draft document; page 12 states it is ready for final review and approval only after checklist items are closed. It is not an approved PPK.
Contains unresolved establishment-profile fields, including responsible person, equipment details, address confirmation and actual operating parameters.
The six CCP entries are preliminary; the document itself requires hazard-analysis confirmation and completion of critical limits, monitoring frequency, responsible roles and corrective actions.
Proposed quarterly/annual laboratory intervals are expressly presented as internal planning proposals, not universal statutory periods.
References to legal acts and dates are not independently verified by this source record; legal applicability must be checked against official current texts.
The 16 HACCP instruction titles are listed in the register, but their individual source files and current approved versions are not established by this 12-page document.
Business identifiers, personal contacts and exact establishment address are intentionally excluded from generalized knowledge.
